dataset.description: UV-Vis, luminescence, NMR and chromatographic data of synthesized compounds: substituted 8-hydroxyquinolinato ligands, naphthyl substituted anthracene fragment containing 8-quinolinato ligands and the respective aluminum complexes with all synthesized ligands.

distribution.title: The aim of the data acquisition is to analyze structure of all synthesized compounds and complexes and determine degree of purity. The data will be acquired using the scientific equipment available at the Institute of Chemistry and Chemical Technology of the Faculty of Natural Sciences and Technology of RTU.

dataset.title: Spectroscopy data of synthesized compounds

dataset.description:
Optical properties of synthesized compounds in thin films will be investigated. Studied optical properties will include absorption and emission spectra, photoluminescence quantum yield and photoluminescence kinetics. Amplified spontaneous emission of prepared thin films will be measured by the variable stripe
method.

distribution.title: The aim of the data acquisition is to characterize thin films from synthesized compounds and investigate suitability for laser applications. The data will be acquired using the scientific equipment available at the Institute of Solid State Physics of University of Latvia.

dataset.title: Data of thin films composed of synthesized compounds

dmp.description:
The main objective of grant are synthesis of original Al complexes with triplet harvesting substituents containing 8-hydroxyquinolinato derivative ligands and investigation as a potential active matrix in light amplifiers to achieve the best light amplification properties in the red spectral region. Grant activities include synthesis and characterization of substituted 8-hydroxyquinolinato ligands, synthesis and characterization of respective aluminum complexes (Alq3 type complexes) for Förster energy transfer mechanism investigation. Syntheses of similar Alq3 type complexes are planned with naphthyl substituted anthracene fragment containing 8-quinilinato ligands. Properties for use in efficient quasi-CW organic solid-state lasers will be investigated of solution-processable Alq3, substituted anthracenes, Alq3:DWK and Alq3:substituted anthracenes: DWK thin films.
The DMP is going to ensure the quality, availability and sustainability of the data while contributing to achieving the goal of the grant and increasing the impacts of the project results in both the scientific and practical fields. The data will include characterization information of synthesized organic compounds and information on solid-state laser investigation.
